jobs.title: Senior Embedded Product Cybersecurity Engineer
jobs.description: Senior Embedded Product Cybersecurity Engineer About L4B Software L4B Software specializes in embedded software engineering, platform development and product cybersecurity. We work with Embedded Linux, Android/AOSP, board support packages (BSPs) and real-time embedded systems to develop reliable, secure and maintainable software platforms. Our engineering work supports industries including medical devices, consumer electronics and other connected embedded products where security must be integrated throughout the product lifecycle. About the Role We are looking for a Senior Embedded Product Cybersecurity Engineer with strong hands-on experience securing embedded devices and connected products, particularly in consumer electronics or medical-device environments . This is a hands-on engineering position, not a general IT cybersecurity, SOC, network security or compliance-only role. You will work directly with embedded software, platform and product-engineering teams to design, implement, test and maintain security mechanisms across device hardware, bootloaders, operating systems, firmware and software-update infrastructure. We are particularly interested in engineers who have contributed to security architectures and controls in real products, from development and integration through production release and ongoing maintenance. Key Responsibilities 1. Embedded Product Security Architecture Design and implement security architectures for Embedded Linux, Android/AOSP and other embedded platforms. Perform device-level threat modeling, attack-surface analysis and security risk assessments. Identify threats involving physical device access, debug interfaces, firmware extraction, communication interfaces and software vulnerabilities. Translate security requirements into practical technical controls and engineering tasks. Collaborate with hardware, BSP, platform and application engineers to implement security by design. 2. Secure Boot, Device Identity and Cryptography Implement and validate Secure Boot, Verified Boot and chain-of-trust mechanisms. Work with hardware-backed security technologies such as TPM, HSM, secure elements, ARM TrustZone and OP-TEE, as applicable. Design secure device identity, key provisioning, key storage and key lifecycle mechanisms. Implement cryptographic signing, integrity verification and secure firmware authentication. Support secure manufacturing provisioning and device lifecycle security. 3. Embedded Linux and Android Platform Hardening Implement security controls within Embedded Linux and, where applicable, Android/AOSP platforms. Harden bootloaders, Linux kernels, operating-system configurations and device services. Work with Linux security mechanisms such as SELinux, AppArmor, dm-verity, dm-crypt and filesystem protection. Reduce attack surfaces by securing services, ports, permissions, interfaces and debug capabilities. Collaborate with Yocto/BSP engineers to integrate security controls into production firmware images. 4. Secure Firmware Updates and Product Lifecycle Security Design and implement secure firmware and OTA update mechanisms. Ensure firmware authenticity, integrity, rollback protection and secure recovery. Support secure update architectures for connected and field-deployed products. Investigate product vulnerabilities and contribute to remediation across supported software versions. Help establish security maintenance practices for products throughout their operational lifecycle. 5. Vulnerability Management and Security Verification Perform vulnerability analysis across embedded firmware, operating systems, libraries and third-party components. Work with CVE databases, software composition analysis and SBOM generation. Assess vulnerability exploitability and product-specific security impact. Support static analysis, dynamic analysis, firmware analysis and penetration-testing activities. Develop or integrate security verification into CI/CD pipelines. Document security findings, remediation actions and verification evidence. 6. Product Security and Engineering Collaboration Work closely with Embedded Linux, Android/AOSP, BSP, hardware, DevSecOps, QA and product-engineering teams. Participate in security design reviews and technical risk assessments. Support security requirements, verification and traceability for regulated or security-sensitive products. Contribute to product-security documentation and technical security decisions. Independently investigate and resolve complex embedded security issues. Required Qualifications and Experience Strong professional experience in embedded software engineering, with substantial hands-on responsibility for embedded product cybersecurity. Professional experience securing consumer electronics, medical devices or comparable connected embedded products. Strong understanding of embedded hardware, firmware, bootloaders, operating systems and device security boundaries. Hands-on experience implementing security controls in Embedded Linux, Android/AOSP or comparable embedded platforms. Demonstrated practical experience in several of the following: Secure Boot, Verified Boot or hardware root of trust. Secure key storage, provisioning and cryptographic integration. Embedded Linux security hardening. Secure firmware updates and rollback protection. Device-level threat modeling and attack-surface reduction. Embedded vulnerability analysis and remediation. Strong Linux debugging and embedded systems troubleshooting skills. Proficiency in C/C++ and scripting with Python or Bash. Ability to independently own technical security tasks from design through implementation and verification. Experience working with cross-functional product-development teams. Preferred Qualifications Direct experience with consumer electronics , connected devices, smart home products, multimedia devices, wearables or other commercially deployed embedded products. Experience developing or securing medical-device software , connected medical equipment or regulated healthcare products. Practical experience with ARM TrustZone, OP-TEE, TPM, secure elements or hardware security modules. Experience with Yocto/OpenEmbedded, U-Boot, Linux kernel configuration and BSP security integration. Android Verified Boot (AVB), Android security architecture or SELinux policy development. Secure OTA frameworks and firmware-signing infrastructure. Experience with SBOM tooling, CVE assessment and software composition analysis. Familiarity with applicable product-security standards and guidance, such as IEC 62443, ETSI EN 303 645, IEC 81001-5-1, IEC 62304, ISO 14971 or relevant EU Cyber Resilience Act requirements. Experience supporting security verification, technical documentation and product-security audits. Experience working on products requiring long-term security maintenance and vulnerability response. What We Are Looking For We are particularly interested in engineers who can demonstrate: Security mechanisms they have personally designed, implemented, integrated or validated . Experience working with actual embedded products rather than security concepts alone. Understanding of how hardware, firmware, operating systems and connectivity affect device security. Ability to investigate vulnerabilities and implement practical remediation. Ownership of technical decisions and security deliverables. Clear communication with embedded engineering and product teams. Important: This position requires practical embedded product-security engineering experience. General IT security, SOC operations, infrastructure security, penetration testing without embedded-product engineering, or compliance-only experience will not independently meet the role requirements. Why Join L4B Software ? Work on embedded platform and product-security engineering challenges. Contribute to secure software platforms used in complex connected products. Collaborate with international engineering teams. Take ownership of meaningful security design and implementation responsibilities. Work in an environment where technical depth, independent problem-solving and engineering quality matter. Application Please share your resume highlighting the embedded products and platforms you have worked on, the security mechanisms you personally implemented, and your experience with production or commercially deployed devices. L4B Software is committed to fair and inclusive recruitment. Candidates will be assessed on demonstrated technical capabilities and alignment with the requirements of the role. ﻿﻿ Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.description: About the role You’ll be the engineer our managed services clients rely on when something looks wrong in their AWS accounts or on their endpoints, and the one who makes sure it doesn’t happen twice.You will run AWS-native security services and enterprise EDR/XDR platforms across many client environments, lead incident response from the first alert to the root cause, manage devices through Microsoft Intune, and keep the controls and evidence clients need for SOC 2. The stack you’ll own: Five layers, many client environments. These are the services and tools you’ll work with every week. AWS foundation Accounts, identity, encryption and network edges AWS Organizations & SCPs Control Tower IAM & IAM Identity Center IAM Access Analyzer KMS Secrets Manager VPC & Network Firewall AWS WAF & Shield Cloud workloads EC2, containers and serverless, protected by AWS-native and thirdparty tools CrowdStrike Falcon Cloud Security Trend Micro Vision One / Cloud One Workload Security Bitdefender GravityZone Amazon Inspector GuardDuty Runtime Monitoring Systems Manager Patch Manager ECR image scanning Amazon EKS Endpoints, mobile and email Laptops, servers, phones and the mailboxes people use on them CrowdStrike Falcon SentinelOne Singularity Microsoft Defender for Endpoint Bitdefender GravityZone Microsoft Intune Intune app protection (MAM) Microsoft Entra ID Conditional Access Microsoft Defender for Office 365 SPF, DKIM & DMARC Detection and response EDR, XDR and MDR working as one service Amazon GuardDuty AWS Security Hub Amazon Detective AWS Security Incident Response Microsoft Sentinel Microsoft Defender XDR MDR partners Compliance and evidence Proof that controls work, ready for auditors SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria AWS Config conformance packs AWS Audit Manager AWS CloudTrail CIS Benchmarks Key responsibilities: AWS cloud security Design and run a multi-account security architecture for each client: a dedicated security tooling account with delegated administration for GuardDuty, Security Hub, Inspector, Macie and Detective, and an organization-wide CloudTrail delivered to a locked-down log archive account. Enable and tune GuardDuty protection plans (S3, EKS, Runtime Monitoring, Malware Protection, RDS and Lambda), maintain suppression rules, and route findings by severity to the right queue and on-call engineer. nClouds : Cloud Security Engineer Page 2 of 7 Operate Security Hub with central configuration across the organization: enable standards (AWS Foundational Security Best Practices, CIS, PCI DSS and NIST SP800-53), build automation rules and custom insights, and keep findings deduplicated. Own identity security: IAM Identity Center permission sets, service control and resource control policies, permission boundaries, cross-account role trust reviews, root account protection, MFA enforcement, access key rotation, and IAM Access Analyzer findings for external and unused access. Protect data with KMS key policies and rotation, S3 Block Public Access and bucket policy reviews, default EBS and RDS encryption, Secrets Manager rotation and Macie sensitive data discovery. Harden networks through security group and NACL reviews, AWS Network Firewall, Route 53 Resolver DNS Firewall, VPC endpoints, WAF managed and rate-based rules, Shield Advanced and VPC Flow Log analysis. Secure containers and serverless: EKS cluster hardening, EKS Pod Identity or IRSA, Kubernetes RBAC and audit logs, ECR enhanced scanning, and least-privilege Lambda execution roles. Build auto-remediation for common risks, such as public S3 buckets, security groups open to the internet on SSH or RDP, disabled logging and exposed access keys, using AWS Config rules, EventBridge, Lambda and Systems Manager Automation. Centralize security logs (CloudTrail, VPC Flow Logs, DNS, WAF and load balancer logs) in Amazon Security Lake or the client’s SIEM, with retention set to meet compliance needs. Run security posture reviews against the CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark, AWS Foundational Security Best Practices and the Well-Architected Security pillar, then drive remediation with the client. Review Terraform and CloudFormation changes for security misconfigurations before they reach production. Third-party cloud and workload security on AWS Deploy and manage third-party cloud security platforms alongside AWS-native services, including CrowdStrike Falcon Cloud Security, Trend Micro Vision One and Bitdefender GravityZone, covering workload protection, cloud posture (CSPM) and container security. Onboard client AWS organizations to these platforms with least-privilege cross-account IAM roles, deployed at scale through CloudFormation StackSets or Terraform, and monitor connector health so no account drops out of coverage. Roll out and maintain sensors and agents on Linux and Windows EC2 instances, golden AMIs, Auto Scaling groups and EKS clusters using Systems Manager Distributor and State Manager, user data or Helm, and manage kernel compatibility and sensor upgrades. Configure workload protection policies covering anti-malware, IPS and virtual patching, integrity monitoring, log inspection, application control and host firewall, tuned so production performance isn’t affected. Choose between agent-based and agentless (snapshot) scanning for each workload type, and explain the coverage trade-offs of each. Correlate and deduplicate findings between AWS-native and third-party tools, forward them to Security Hub or the SIEM, and agree a single source of truth per control to avoid overlap and alert fatigue. nClouds : Cloud Security Engineer Page 3 of 7 Reconcile EC2 and EKS inventory against each tool’s console every month to catch unprotected instances, stale agents and licensing gaps. Advise clients on where AWS-native services are enough and where a third-party tool is needed, and run migrations between tools without losing coverage. Endpoint and EDR/XDR administration Administer EDR/XDR platforms, including CrowdStrike Falcon, SentinelOne, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint and Defender XDR, Trend Micro Vision One and Bitdefender GravityZone: sensor rollout and health, device groups, response actions and integrations. Publish regular agent coverage reports so no unprotected laptop, server or workload goes unnoticed. Laptop, mobile and email protection Handle malware detections end to end: confirm the alert, kill or quarantine the threat, isolate the device if needed, remove persistence, confirm the device is clean, and restore, roll back or reimage where required. Contain ransomware on endpoints quickly using EDR isolation and rollback features, and work with backup owners on recovery. Triage reported and detected phishing, business email compromise and malicious attachments or links: trace the message, purge it from every mailbox, block the sender, domain or URL, and reset and review any compromised account. Manage Windows, macOS, iOS and Android devices in Microsoft Intune: enrollment (Windows Autopilot, Apple Automated Device Enrollment, Android Enterprise), compliance policies, configuration profiles, BitLocker and FileVault encryption, Defender onboarding and Conditional Access with Microsoft Entra ID. Protect personal (BYOD) devices with Intune app protection policies, and handle lost or stolen devices with remote lock, selective wipe or full wipe. Enforce device control for USB and removable media, application control, web content filtering, browser and extension policies, and OS and third-party app patching through Intune. Security policy design and audits Write, configure and maintain the security policies inside each tool: EDR prevention and detection policies, Defender attack surface reduction rules, Intune compliance, configuration and app protection policies, Conditional Access, email protection policies, cloud workload policies in CrowdStrike, Trend Micro and Bitdefender, and AWS SCPs and Security Hub standards. Build and maintain nClouds ’ standard policy baseline for each tool, keep it under version and change control, and apply it consistently when onboarding new clients. Audit policy configuration across client tenants on a regular schedule against that baseline, vendor recommendations, CIS Benchmarks and the client’s own standards, and flag drift, gaps, disabled protections and overly broad exclusions. Review exclusion and exception requests, document the risk and approval, and set a review date for each one. Draft the security policy documents that back these configurations (endpoint security, mobile device, email security, acceptable use and incident response), and turn audit findings into client reports and SOC 2 evidence. nClouds : Cloud Security Engineer Page 4 of 7 Detection, MDR and incident response Triage and investigate escalated alerts from GuardDuty, Security Hub, Microsoft Sentinel, Defender XDR and EDR consoles; separate real threats from noise quickly and record the reasoning. Lead incident response end to end following NIST SP800-61: scope affected accounts and hosts, contain (isolate endpoints, disable or rotate credentials, quarantine IAM access keys, snapshot volumes for forensics), eradicate, recover and write the RCA. Use AWS Security Incident Response for case management, triage and containment on AWS, and work alongside MDR partners and client security teams during active incidents. Write and tune detections mapped to MITRE ATT&CK in KQL, CloudWatch Logs Insights and Athena, reducing false positives without opening detection gaps. Automate repeatable response with EventBridge, Lambda, Step Functions, Systems Manager and Sentinel playbooks. Act as the security escalation point for the 24×7 Managed Services shifts, and maintain the runbooks and playbooks they follow. SOC 2, compliance and vulnerability management Map AWS and endpoint controls to the SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria (security, availability and confidentiality), and support HIPAA, PCI DSS and ISO 27001 requirements where clients need them. Collect and maintain audit evidence with AWS Config conformance packs, Security Hub standards and AWS Audit Manager; support clients through SOC 2 Type II audits and nClouds through AWS MSPPartner validation. Run vulnerability management across cloud and endpoints with Amazon Inspector, Defender Vulnerability Management and Trend Micro; track remediation against patching SLAs and report trends month over month. Clients and the practice: Write clear incident reports, monthly security posture reports and executive summaries for US-based client stakeholders, and present them on client calls. Help shape nClouds ’ managed security service through tool evaluations, standard configurations, onboarding checklists and new offerings. Coach Managed Services engineers on security fundamentals and share what you learn through internal sessions and blog posts. Qualifications: Must have 3–6 years in cloud security, security operations or security engineering, including at least 2 years securing production AWS environments. Hands-on experience with core AWS security services (GuardDuty, Security Hub, Inspector, CloudTrail, Config, IAM, KMS, WAF) in multi-account setups, including delegated administration, organization-wide logging and IAM policy analysis. nClouds : Cloud Security Engineer Page 5 of 7 Hands-on experience protecting AWS workloads with at least one third-party cloud security platform, such as CrowdStrike Falcon Cloud Security, Trend Micro Vision One or Bitdefender GravityZone, including AWS account integration, agent rollout and policy configuration. Administration experience with at least two of CrowdStrike Falcon, SentinelOne, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint/XDR, Trend Micro (Vision One, Cloud One or Deep Security) and Bitdefender GravityZone. Working experience with Microsoft Intune and Microsoft Entra ID, including device compliance and Conditional Access. Hands-on experience writing, tuning and auditing security policies in EDR/XDR, Intune, Defender and email security consoles, not only responding to their alerts. Practical experience handling malware and phishing incidents on laptops and mobile devices (see the knowledge areas below). Proven incident response experience from triage to RCA, with working knowledge of NIST incident handling, MITRE ATT&CK and the cyber kill chain. A clear understanding of how EDR, XDR and MDR differ and how they fit together in a managed security service. Knowledge of the SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria and how technical controls become audit evidence. Query skills in KQL plus at least one of CloudWatch Logs Insights, Athena SQL on CloudTrail or another SIEM query language. Scripting in Python, PowerShell or Bash to automate investigation and remediation. Solid networking and OS fundamentals: TCP/IP, DNS, TLS, firewalls, and Windows and Linux internals. Strong written and spoken English, and the confidence to lead a client call during an incident. Good to have Certifications such as AWS Certified Security – Specialty, Microsoft SC-200, MD-102 or AZ- 500, a CrowdStrike Falcon certification, CompTIA Security+ or CySA+, CCSPor CISSP. Terraform or CloudFormation, plus policy-as-code tools such as Checkov, tfsec or OPA. Container and Kubernetes security on EKS: image scanning, runtime protection and RBAC. Prior experience at an MSPor MSSPserving several clients at once. nClouds : Cloud Security Engineer Page 6 of 7 Laptop, mobile and email protection knowledge We expect working knowledge in each of these areas, and depth in at least a few of them. Identity and access on devices Device-based Conditional Access; MFA and phishingresistant methods such as Windows Hello for Business and passkeys; session token theft; credential dumping and pass-the-hash; least privilege for local accounts. Patching, web and data protection OS and third-party patching through Intune; web content filtering, SmartScreen and network protection; browser and extension control; USB and removable media control; endpoint DLPbasics.
